summary: Treat --category slugs as equivalent after lowercasing and collapsing '-', '_', and spaces so help text like sans-serif matches stored names like Sans Serif.
reason: Google Fonts metadata stores display names with spaces (Sans Serif). list and random compared the raw lowercased string, so the documented hyphen slug returned 0 fonts while categories still reported hundreds.
validated_outcome: go test in the gfonts module passes: hyphen slug, stored display name, and space form match Sans Serif; unrelated, empty, and unknown slugs return no fonts.
